notes: Curated eval focused on live-conversation usefulness rather than generic copywriting.

should_trigger.prompt: Create a discovery talk track for enterprise AEs selling to VP Operations. It should diagnose urgency, surface workflow pain, handle a likely 'we already have a process' objection, and end with a concrete next-step ask.

Build a renewal-expansion talk track for CSMs preparing for a pricing increase conversation with skeptical customers. Keep it natural and add branch paths for budget pressure and competitor comparisons.
I need a demo talk track for SEs with role-specific transitions, proof inserts under 20 seconds, and manager inspection cues so leaders can coach against it.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Create the core positioning strategy and differentiated value proposition for our new AI analytics product.
Build a governed objection library with approved responses, escalation rules, and response status labels.
Outline a one-pager and deck narrative for our annual kickoff presentation.

output_structure_checks.name: talk-track-builder-output-01
output_structure_checks.description: The output substantively includes: Talk tracks versioned by role, persona, and stage

output_structure_checks.name: talk-track-builder-output-02
output_structure_checks.description: The output substantively includes: Discovery question set grouped by objective

output_structure_checks.name: talk-track-builder-output-03
output_structure_checks.description: The output substantively includes: Transition lines and checkpoint language

output_structure_checks.name: talk-track-builder-output-04
output_structure_checks.description: The output substantively includes: Proof snippets and when to deploy them

output_structure_checks.name: talk-track-builder-output-05
output_structure_checks.description: The output substantively includes: Branch-path response lines for common derailments

task_scenarios.prompt: Review message-inputs.md and build a natural 12-minute discovery talk track for the first substantive call. Give the AE an opening frame, a short question path, transitions, and branch responses for the two likely objections. End with a concrete next-step ask. Keep proof inside the approved boundaries and make any unsupported area explicit.

assertions.name: talk-track-live-structure
assertions.description: Includes one call objective, a progressive question path, objection branches, transitions, and one explicit next-step ask.

assertions.name: talk-track-proof-boundaries
assertions.description: Retains the pilot caveat and does not generalize standard-integration evidence to custom ERP work.

assertions.name: talk-track-no-invention
assertions.description: Does not invent pricing, customer logos, implementation guarantees, or universal ROI.
